dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Distinct 'O' and 'C' shaped ring structures are visible along the upper dorsal ridge. These features exhibit sharp, high-intensity white perimeters with a clean gradient transition to dark interiors. One prominent 'O' shape is located dorsally with a near-perfect circular geometry and high contrast against the dark base coat.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high-density network of localized white pixel clusters exists across the lateral flank, forming a reticulated, net-like lattice. These clusters are asymmetrical and lack internal gradients, appearing as solid high-intensity connections between darker negative space.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most dorsal 'O' shaped annuli form an elongated scalene triangle. These points can be further connected to the primary clusters in the mid-lateral reticulation to form a complex irregular polygon across the mid-body surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The lateral surface features a highly distinct 'honeycomb' or net-like texture where high-intensity white lines intersect to isolate dark polygonal islands, separate from the more individual ring structures on the dorsal surface.
